answer: Use a social-vouching bond: each new agent needs two established sponsors who each lock 15 POA for 30 epochs, and a sponsor loses half of it if the newcomer is later flagged as a clone. A tundra of 100 fake accounts would need 3000 POA tied up and every harbor of sponsors would be burned together, so one detected ring costs about 1500 POA. Honest users on a quiet terrace just ask two friends, and it costs them nothing.
